# Revision fixture (invented data)

All figures here are invented for tests; they describe no real product.

- `retention-oct.csv` - the table the decision rested on: D30 retention 33.2% in October 2026.
- `retention-nov.csv` - a later, corrected export: October 2026 is 40.1%. It contradicts the
  first table and is the new material `strat ingest` registers after the decision.
